requirements.title: World Authority & Player Intent
requirements.requirementText: Player wording expresses intent and never creates external world facts. Deterministic game systems remain authoritative.
requirements.notes: Single canonical authority enforced in Node.js server runtime.

evidences.description: ServerMockAuthority validates player intents before updating world state.
Integration test verifies intent validation and state isolation.

requirements.title: World Clock & Temporal Simulation
requirements.requirementText: Canonical simulation clock tracks calendar date, elapsed seconds, seasons, and day/night phases deterministically.
requirements.notes: Pure arithmetic date/time accumulator with countdown calculations.

evidences.description: WorldClock handles deterministic date accumulator.
Unit/integration suite verifies clock tick calculation.

requirements.title: Geography Graph & Spatial Data
requirements.requirementText: Geography is data, not a picture. Nodes, edges, terrain modifiers, travel modes, and hazard profiles.
requirements.notes: Dijkstra route planner with terrain duration math.

evidences.description: GeographyGraph graph implementation.
Dijkstra route calculation test suite.

requirements.title: Simulated Travel & Origin Anchoring

requirements.notes: Zero double-location authority. Origin anchoring strictly verified.

evidences.description: PlayerLifecycleState location anchoring logic.
Travel journey origin anchoring test.

requirements.title: Character Knowledge Records & Boundary
requirements.requirementText: Every piece of factual information has owner, observable source, confidence, and secret level. Hidden information is never leaked.

evidences.description: Epistemic boundary filtering.
Epistemic location projection suite.

evidences.description: IActorLifecycle implementation.
Actor lifecycle test suite.

Historical evidence test suite.
